items.example: I remember when we first met at that coffee shop.
That reminds me of our trip to Barcelona.
Back then, we didn't have mobile phones.
In those days, we used to write letters to each other.
It all started when we sat next to each other in class.
The funniest thing was that he had spaghetti on his shirt the whole time.
We met at art school and got on well immediately.

items.phrase: When did you last go on holiday?
items.translation: Когда ты в последний раз ездил в отпуск?
items.example: When did you last go on holiday? I went to Malta with some friends.

items.phrase: It was a few months ago
items.example: When did you last see your best friend? It was a few months ago.
